application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
description:
T45: Tilia cordata (small-leaved lime), current height 5m. Basal growth partially obstructing footpath. Significant decay howling of 2m high stump. Pollard to 2m and trim back basal growth back to fence to clear footpath. 
T47: Tilia cordata (small-leave lime), current height 15m. Unable to fully assess base due to obstructive vegetation. Basal growth partially obstructing the footpath. Trim back basal growth back to fence to clear the footpath.  
T5: Tilia
Reduce crown and by up to 2m in height and reduce back sides to match into new top and leaving tree with 
as natural a shape as possible. Carry out climbed inspection of trunk cavity at 2.5m on SE side and 
report back findings

Please refer to the invalid letter for further information regarding the other trees included in the original application.
This application is only valid for the aforementioned trees, T5, T45 and T47.
